series.name: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)
series.notes: This is the mainstream PV1800 line sold in Pakistan (PV18-2012/2412/2424/3024/3048/4024/4048/5048/5548 VHM/VPK). Manual also covers the 120VAC LHM/LV variant. CONFLICT WARNING: PV1800 ECO / VPM II use DIFFERENT wording for codes 03, 52 and 58 - see SERIES 2, never merge. Codes 80-90 (parallel) are in SERIES 4; the PV1800 2K/3K HM service manual maps the same numbers to board-repair sections - see SERIES 5.

title.en: Fan locked while inverter was off
title.ur: Fan off state mein atak gaya

meaning.en: The cooling fan did not turn while the inverter was off, so the manual flags it as a fan fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter band hone ke waqt cooling fan nahi chala, is liye manual isay fan fault kehta hai.

causes.en: Cooling fan is jammed by dust or a foreign object.
causes.ur: Cooling fan dust ya kisi foreign object se jam ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Fan motor has failed or its driver circuit on the main board is open.
causes.ur: Fan motor kharab ho gaya hai ya main board par uska driver circuit open hai.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, then open the unit and spin the fan by hand to check for a jam.
solutions.ur: Unit off karein, AC, PV aur battery disconnect karke kholein, phir haath se fan ghumayein aur check karein ke ghisat to nahi.

solutions.en: Replace the fan with the same size and rating, then power on with PV and battery disconnected.
solutions.ur: Wahi size aur rating ka fan replace karein, phir PV aur battery disconnect karke power on karein.

solutions.en: If a new fan still gives 01, the fan driver section on the main board is faulty - send to service centre.
solutions.ur: Naya fan lagane par bhi 01 aaye to main board ka fan driver section kharab hai, unit service centre bhejein.

notes.en: Manual troubleshooting row for 01 reads simply 'Fan fault'. The PV1800 2K/3K HM service manual gives the component-level procedure (replace fan, then check fan drive circuit).
notes.ur: Manual troubleshooting mein 01 ke liye sirf 'Fan fault' likha hai. PV1800 2K/3K HM service manual component-level tareeqa deta hai: fan replace karein, phir fan drive circuit check karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Inverter transformer zyada garm ho gaya

meaning.en: Internal temperature of an inverter component went above the over-temperature threshold.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke kisi component ka temperature safe limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Air flow around the unit is blocked or the anti-dust mesh is clogged.
causes.ur: Unit ke aas paas hawa ka raste band hain ya anti-dust mesh ghus gaya hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature is too high for the installation room.
causes.ur: Installation jagah ka ambient temperature zyada hai.

causes.en: Fan has failed so the heatsink never gets cooled.
causes.ur: Fan kharab ho gaya hai jis se heatsink kabhi thanda nahi hota.

solutions.en: Switch off and disconnect AC, PV and battery before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle off karein aur AC, PV aur battery disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: Clean dust off the fan and the anti-dust mesh, and clear 200 mm space at the sides and 300 mm above the unit.
solutions.ur: Fan aur anti-dust mesh ki dust saaf karein, aur unit ke dono taraf 200 mm aur upar 300 mm jagah khali rakhein.

solutions.en: Measure the heatsink NTC resistance with a multimeter; it should read close to its marked value, otherwise replace the NTC.
solutions.ur: Heatsink NTC ka resistance multimeter se check karein, marked value ke qareeb hona chahiye, warna NTC replace karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Battery voltage zyada high hai

meaning.en: Measured battery voltage exceeded the safe charging limit, so the charger stopped.
meaning.ur: Battery ka voltage safe charging limit se upar chala gaya, is liye charger band ho gaya.

causes.en: Too many battery cells in series for the inverter's battery voltage setting.
causes.ur: Inverter ki battery voltage setting ke mutabiq series mein cells zyada lagaye gaye hain.

causes.en: Battery type is set wrong in the LCD menu, so the float/boost voltage is too high for the pack.
causes.ur: LCD menu mein battery type galat set hai, jis se pack ke liye float/boost voltage zyada ho gaya hai.

causes.en: An external charger is connected to the same battery and is overcharging it.
causes.ur: Usi battery par external charger lagi hai aur woh overcharge kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter; for a 48 V lead-acid pack anything above about 58 V DC is over-charge.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage multimeter se check karein; 48 V lead-acid pack mein 58 V DC se upar ka matlab over-charge hai.

solutions.en: On the LCD, re-check Program 14 battery type and the max charge voltage to match the actual battery spec sheet.
solutions.ur: LCD par Program 14 battery type aur max charge voltage dobara check karein aur asli battery spec sheet se match karein.

solutions.en: Count the battery strings and confirm the series voltage matches the inverter's nominal battery voltage.
solutions.ur: Battery strings gin lein aur confirm karein ke series voltage inverter ke nominal battery voltage se match karti hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Battery voltage bahut low hai

meaning.en: Battery fell below the inverter's discharge cut-off, so the unit shut down.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage inverter ke discharge cut-off se neeche gir gaya, is liye unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Battery bank is deeply discharged or has aged and lost capacity.
causes.ur: Battery bank poori tarah discharge ho chuki hai ya umar ke saath capacity khota gaya hai.

causes.en: Load is too large for the battery bank, draining it faster than it charges.
causes.ur: Load battery bank ke liye zyada hai aur battery charge se tez drain ho rahi hai.

causes.en: Battery terminals are loose or corroded so the inverter reads a false low voltage.
causes.ur: Battery terminals loose ya corroded hain jis se inverter ko jhooti low voltage dikhti hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the load and measure battery voltage; for a 48 V pack the DC cut-off is around 40-42 V.
solutions.ur: Load disconnect karke battery voltage check karein; 48 V pack mein DC cut-off aazman 40-42 V hota hai.

solutions.en: Clean and tighten the battery terminals with a torque wrench, then re-measure at the inverter's battery terminal.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals saaf aur torque wrench se tight karein, phir inverter ke battery terminal par dobara voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Recharge the bank on AC or PV and confirm charge current is actually flowing before loading it again.
solutions.ur: Bank ko AC ya PV se recharge karein aur load dene se pehle confirm karein ke charge current actually ja raha hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Output short circuit ho gaya

meaning.en: The AC output or load wiring has a short, so the inverter cut the output to protect itself.
meaning.ur: AC output ya load wiring mein short hai, is liye inverter ne apni protection ke liye output cut kar diya.

causes.en: A load's internal wiring or insulation has failed and is touching the live conductor.
causes.ur: Kisi load ki internal wiring ya insulation kharab ho kar live conductor ko chhu rahi hai.

causes.en: AC output terminals are loose, or a strand of copper has bridged L and N.
causes.ur: AC output terminals loose hain, ya copper ka taar L aur N ko short kar raha hai.

causes.en: A motor or pump load has locked up and drawn very high current.
causes.ur: Koi motor ya pump load jam ho gaya aur bohat zyada current kheech raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate AC, PV and battery before touching any wiring.
solutions.ur: Wiring chhoone se pehle inverter off karein aur AC, PV aur battery disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all loads one by one and re-power the inverter to find which circuit is shorted.
solutions.ur: Ek ek karke saare loads disconnect karein aur inverter dobara chala kar dekhein ke kaun sa circuit short hai.

solutions.en: With loads removed, measure continuity between L, N and PE with a multimeter; any near-zero reading means a wiring short.
solutions.ur: Loads nikal kar L, N aur PE ke darmiyan multimeter se continuity check karein; zero ke qareeb reading ka matlab wiring short hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Inverter output voltage zyada high hai

meaning.en: The inverter measured an output voltage outside the acceptable window, so it shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne acceptable range se bahar output voltage paa liya, is liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Battery bank is over-charged so the inverter output rides far above the set value.
causes.ur: Battery bank over-charged hai jis se inverter output set value se kaafi upar chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Output voltage sensor circuit or its feedback is faulty.
causes.ur: Output voltage sensor circuit ya uska feedback kharab hai.

causes.en: Grid quality is poor or another grid-tie unit is back-feeding the same bus.
causes.ur: Grid quality kharab hai ya doosra grid-tie unit usi bus par back-feed kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Read the actual output voltage on the LCD and compare it with the output voltage setting in the menu.
solutions.ur: LCD par asal output voltage dekhein aur menu ki output voltage setting se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load first, as the manual troubleshooting row for 06/58 instructs.
solutions.ur: Pehle connected load kam karein, jaisa manual ki 06/58 troubleshooting row mein likha hai.

solutions.en: If the reading is correct but the fault stays, return the unit to the repair centre - the output voltage sense circuit is a board-level fault.
solutions.ur: Reading theek ho phir bhi fault rahe to unit repair centre bhejein, output voltage sense circuit board level ka fault hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Overload ka time out ho gaya

meaning.en: The inverter ran above 110 percent of rated load until the overload timer expired and it shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter rated load ke 110 percent se upar chala, overload timer khatam hua aur unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Too many appliances are connected at once, or a large motor draws a heavy start-up surge.
causes.ur: Ek saath bohat zyada appliances lagi hain, ya koi bada motor start karte waqt surge leta hai.

causes.en: A compressor or chiller was recently started and its inrush current tripped the protection.
causes.ur: Koi compressor ya chiller abhi start hua aur uska inrush current protection chala gaya.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter, isolate AC, PV and battery, then remove loads progressively.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karein, AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir loads ek ek karke kam karein.

solutions.en: Add up the running load in watts on the LCD and keep it under the rated power of the unit.
solutions.ur: LCD par chal rahe load ko watts mein jama karein aur unit ki rated power se neeche rakhein.

solutions.en: For air conditioners and fridges, allow 2-3 minutes restart delay and avoid frequent on-off from the supply.
solutions.ur: Air conditioner aur fridge ke liye 2-3 minute ka restart delay rakhein aur baar baar supply se on-off na karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Inverter bus voltage zyada high hai

meaning.en: The internal DC bus rose above its limit, which the manual groups with internal component failure.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus apni limit se upar chala gaya, jise manual internal component failure ke saath group karta hai.

causes.en: PV array open-circuit voltage is above what this model accepts, charging the bus too high.
causes.ur: PV array ka open-circuit voltage model se zyada hai aur bus ko over-charge kar raha hai.

causes.en: Bus soft-start circuit or the bus voltage sense resistor network has failed.
causes.ur: Bus soft-start circuit ya bus voltage sense resistor network kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage in the morning before the inverter starts and compare it with the manual's max PV Voc.
solutions.ur: Subah inverter chalu hone se pehle PV open-circuit voltage check karein aur manual ke max PV Voc se compare karein.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, and check the bus voltage sense divider resistors on the main board with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir main board par bus voltage sense divider resistors multimeter se check karein.

solutions.en: The manual groups 08/09/53/57 as 'Internal components failed - return to repair centre'; treat it as a board-level job.
solutions.ur: Manual 08/09/53/57 ko 'Internal components failed - repair centre bhejein' ke tor par rakhta hai, ise board level ka kaam samajhein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Bus soft start fail ho gaya

meaning.en: The bus voltage did not build up during soft start, so the unit locked out.
meaning.ur: Soft start ke dauran bus voltage nahi bana, is liye unit lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Soft-start relay or its driver on the main board has failed open.
causes.ur: Main board par soft-start relay ya uska driver open fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Bus voltage stayed low because the battery is deeply discharged or not connected.
causes.ur: Bus voltage low reh gaya kyun ke battery poori tarah discharge hai ya connected nahi.

solutions.en: Start the unit with only the battery connected, PV and AC isolated, to separate a battery problem from a board problem.
solutions.ur: Sirf battery ke saath unit chala kar dekhein, PV aur AC disconnect karke, taake battery ka masla aur board ka masla alag ho sake.

solutions.en: Check battery voltage and the DC fuse in the battery path with a multimeter, replace a blown fuse with the same rating.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage aur battery path ka DC fuse multimeter se check karein, ube hua fuse usi rating ka lagayein.

solutions.en: If the bus builds up but the fault repeats, the soft-start circuit is a main-board repair - refer to the service manual.
solutions.ur: Bus ban jaye phir bhi fault dohraye to soft-start circuit main board ka repair hai, service manual dekhein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Main relay fail ho gaya

meaning.en: The unit could not switch the main relay between inverter and grid paths.
meaning.ur: Unit ne main relay ko inverter aur grid ke darmiyan switch nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Relay coil is burnt or the relay contacts have welded from a previous over-current event.
causes.ur: Relay coil jal gaya hai ya pichle over-current se relay contacts weld ho gaye hain.

causes.en: Relay drive transistor or its flyback protection on the control board is open.
causes.ur: Control board par relay drive transistor ya uska flyback protection open hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate AC, PV and battery, then listen for the relay click when power is applied.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir power dete waqt relay ki click check karein.

solutions.en: Measure relay coil resistance with a multimeter; an open or burnt coil means replacing the relay.
solutions.ur: Relay coil ka resistance multimeter se check karein, open ya jal hua coil ka matlab relay replace karna hai.

solutions.en: Verify the AC input breaker is not stuck and the input voltage is inside the selectable range before blaming the relay.
solutions.ur: Relay ko blame karne se pehle check karein ke AC input breaker-atka to nahi aur input voltage range ke andar hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Output voltage sensor mein ghalti

meaning.en: The output voltage sensing feedback is out of range, so the unit cannot trust its own output.
meaning.ur: Output voltage sensing feedback range se bahar hai, is liye unit apne output par bharosa nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Output voltage sense divider or its feedback trace is open or cracked.
causes.ur: Output voltage sense divider ya uski feedback trace open ya crack ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Sensing connector is loose, corroded, or not seated on the control board.
causes.ur: Sensing connector loose, corroded ya control board par sahi se baitha nahi hai.

solutions.en: Power down and isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the output sense connector on the main board.
solutions.ur: Power down karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir main board par output sense connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Measure the sense divider resistors with a multimeter and replace any that read open or far from the marked value.
solutions.ur: Sense divider resistors multimeter se check karein aur open ya marked value se door honay walay replace karein.

solutions.en: This is a board-level fault - the manual directs a return to the repair centre rather than a field fix.
solutions.ur: Yeh board level ka fault hai, manual field fix ke bajaye repair centre bhejne kehta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Grid voltage sensor mein ghalti

meaning.en: The grid voltage sensing channel is reporting an implausible value.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage sensing channel se implausible value aa raha hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage sense circuit is damaged or its calibration has drifted.
causes.ur: Grid voltage sense circuit damage ho gaya hai ya uski calibration bigad gayi hai.

causes.en: Loose or burnt connector in the grid sensing harness.
causes.ur: Grid sensing harness mein connector loose ya jal hua hai.

causes.en: Severe grid disturbance or a neutral problem confusing the sensing reference.
causes.ur: Grid par severe disturbance ya neutral ka masla sensing reference ko confuse kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage directly at the AC input terminal with a multimeter to see what the inverter should be seeing.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se AC input terminal par seedha grid voltage check karein ke inverter ko kya milna chahiye.

solutions.en: Power down, isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat and inspect the grid sense connector for burnt pins.
solutions.ur: Power down karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir grid sense connector dobara baithayein aur jalay huay pins dekhein.

solutions.en: Check the neutral and PE bonding at the distribution board, because a floating neutral corrupts the reading.
solutions.ur: Distribution board par neutral aur PE bonding check karein, floating neutral reading kharab kar deta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Output current sensor mein ghalti

meaning.en: The output current sensing channel is out of range or not credible.
meaning.ur: Output current sensing channel range se bahar ya unreliable value de raha hai.

causes.en: Output current sensor (Hall or shunt) has failed or drifted out of calibration.
causes.ur: Output current sensor (Hall ya shunt) kharab ho gaya hai ya calibration bigad gayi hai.

causes.en: Sensor supply or its signal trace on the main board is open.
causes.ur: Sensor ki supply ya uska signal trace main board par open hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then compare the LCD load current against a clamp meter on the output conductor.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir LCD ka load current output wire par lagaye clamp meter se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor connector and its 5 V supply at the board with a multimeter, and reseat it if loose.
solutions.ur: Board par sensor connector aur uski 5 V supply multimeter se check karein, loose ho to dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: If the sensor output is stuck at zero or full scale, replace the current sensor, not the whole board.
solutions.ur: Agar sensor output zero ya full scale par atak ho to current sensor replace karein, poora board nahi.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Grid current sensor mein ghalti

meaning.en: The grid current sensing channel is out of range or not credible.
meaning.ur: Grid current sensing channel range se bahar ya unreliable value de raha hai.

causes.en: Grid current sensor has failed or lost its zero offset.
causes.ur: Grid current sensor kharab ho gaya hai ya uska zero offset bigad gaya hai.

causes.en: CT or shunt wiring to the sensor is open or badly terminated.
causes.ur: Sensor se CT ya shunt wiring open hai ya behtareen se terminate hui hai.

solutions.en: Compare the LCD grid current with a clamp meter on the grid cable at the same moment.
solutions.ur: Usi waqt LCD ka grid current aur grid cable par clamp meter ki reading compare karein.

solutions.en: Power down, isolate AC, PV and battery, and check the sensor harness continuity and connector pins.
solutions.ur: Power down karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, aur sensor harness ki continuity aur connector pins check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the grid current sensor if it reads open or pinned at full scale, then re-verify current direction in the menu.
solutions.ur: Grid current sensor open ho ya full scale par pin ho to replace karein, phir menu mein current direction dobara verify karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Load current sensor mein ghalti

meaning.en: The load current sensing channel is out of range or not credible.
meaning.ur: Load current sensing channel range se bahar ya unreliable value de raha hai.

causes.en: Load current sensor failed or its hall output is stuck.
causes.ur: Load current sensor kharab ho gaya hai ya uska hall output atak gaya hai.

causes.en: Sensor harness connector is loose or the ribbon is damaged near a moving fan.
causes.ur: Sensor harness connector loose hai ya ribbon fan ke paas damage hua hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and reseat the load current sensor connector on the main board.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein aur main board par load current sensor connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Read the LCD load current and compare it with a clamp meter on the AC output conductor.
solutions.ur: LCD ka load current aur AC output conductor par clamp meter ki reading compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace the load current sensor if its output is stuck, keeping the board if the sensor itself tests good.
solutions.ur: Sensor output atak ho to sensor replace karein, sensor theek nikle to board rakhein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Grid current zyada ho gaya

meaning.en: Current drawn from or fed to the grid exceeded the allowed limit.
meaning.ur: Grid se liya ya grid ko diya gaya current allowed limit se zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid-side breaker or AC input cable is too small for the inverter's current.
causes.ur: Grid side breaker ya AC input cable inverter ke current ke liye choti hai.

causes.en: A large motor or compressor on the same grid is starting at the same time.
causes.ur: Usi grid par koi bada motor ya compressor usi waqt start ho raha hai.

causes.en: Grid transformer or the utility supply is weak and the current rises as a result.
causes.ur: Grid transformer ya utility supply kamzor hai jis se current barh jaata hai.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, then check the grid AC cable size and breaker rating against the manual's table.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phin manual ki table se grid AC cable size aur breaker rating match karein.

solutions.en: Stagger the start of large motors and air conditioners so they do not switch together with the inverter.
solutions.ur: Bade motors aur air conditioners ka start stagger karein taake woh inverter ke saath ek saath na chalein.

solutions.en: Measure grid current with a clamp meter at the peak moment to confirm whether the source or the unit is the limit.
solutions.ur: Peak moment par clamp meter se grid current check karein ke limit source ki hai ya unit ki.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Inverter radiator zyada garm ho gaya

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink or radiator overheated and the unit shut down to protect the IGBTs.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka heatsink ya radiator zyada garm ho gaya aur unit ne IGBT bachane ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Ventilation openings are blocked, or the unit is installed inside a closed cabinet.
causes.ur: Ventilation openings band hain ya unit band cabinet ke andar install hai.

causes.en: Fan has failed or runs slow, so the heatsink is not being cooled.
causes.ur: Fan kharab hai ya dheere chal raha hai, jis se heatsink thanda nahi hota.

causes.en: Room ambient temperature is above the unit's rating.
causes.ur: Kamre ka ambient temperature unit ki rating se upar hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean dust from the heatsink fins and the fan.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir heatsink fins aur fan ki dust saaf karein.

solutions.en: Keep the documented clearance of 200 mm at the sides and 300 mm above and below the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit ke dono taraf 200 mm aur upar neeche 300 mm ki documented clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: If the fan does not spin freely, replace it, then re-run and watch whether 27 returns within a few minutes.
solutions.ur: Agar fan azaad nahi ghoomta to replace karein, phir dobara chala kar dekhein ke kuch hi minute mein 27 wapas aata hai ya nahi.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.en: Solar charger battery voltage class error
title.ur: Solar charger battery voltage class ki ghalti

meaning.en: The MPPT charger detected a battery voltage that does not belong to the configured battery class.
meaning.ur: MPPT charger ne aisi battery voltage paayi jo configured battery class se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Battery nominal voltage setting does not match the connected bank, for example 24 V set on a 48 V bank.
causes.ur: Battery nominal voltage setting connected bank se match nahi karti, maslan 48 V bank par 24 V set hai.

causes.en: One battery string is disconnected or reversed, pushing the bank voltage out of class.
causes.ur: Battery ka aik string disconnect ya reverse hai, jis se bank voltage class se bahar chala gaya.

causes.en: Lithium BMS has cut the pack so the charger sees an abnormal voltage.
causes.ur: Lithium BMS ne pack cut kar diya hai jis se charger ko abnormal voltage dikh rahi hai.

solutions.en: Measure each battery string with a multimeter and confirm every string is within 0.2 V of the others.
solutions.ur: Har battery string multimeter se check karein aur confirm karein ke har string doosron se 0.2 V ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Re-set the battery nominal voltage in the LCD menu to the bank's actual series voltage, then restart.
solutions.ur: LCD menu mein battery nominal voltage bank ki asal series voltage par set karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Check polarity of every string terminal with a multimeter before reconnecting, because a reversed string is the usual cause.
solutions.ur: Reconnect karne se pehle multimeter se har string terminal ki polarity check karein, reversed string hi aam wajah hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Solar charger current sensor mein ghalti

meaning.en: The MPPT charger's current sensing is out of range, so solar charging is stopped.
meaning.ur: MPPT charger ka current sensing range se bahar hai, is liye solar charging band ho gayi.

causes.en: Solar charge current sensor has failed or drifted out of calibration.
causes.ur: Solar charge current sensor kharab ho gaya hai ya calibration bigad gayi hai.

causes.en: Sensor harness or connector on the charger board is open or loose.
causes.ur: Charger board par sensor harness ya connector open ya loose hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the solar charger current sensor connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir solar charger current sensor connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Compare the LCD PV charging current with a clamp meter on the PV cable.
solutions.ur: LCD ka PV charging current aur PV cable par clamp meter ki reading compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace the current sensor if it reads open or pinned, keeping the rest of the board.
solutions.ur: Sensor open ya pin ho to use replace karein, baqi board rakhein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Solar charger current control mein nahi hai

meaning.en: The MPPT current control loop has lost control, so the charger shut itself down.
meaning.ur: MPPT current control loop control kho gaya hai, is liye charger ne khud band ho gaya.

causes.en: PV current has gone far above the configured maximum solar charge current.
causes.ur: PV current configured maximum solar charge current se kaafi upar chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Current control driver or its sensing resistor network on the charger board has failed.
causes.ur: Charger board par current control driver ya uska sensing resistor network kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: PV array is miswired so several strings feed one MPPT input.
causes.ur: PV array galat wired hai aur kai strings aik MPPT input ko feed kar rahi hain.

solutions.en: Check that the PV Voc and Isc of the connected array stay under the manual's limits for this model.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke connected array ki PV Voc aur Isc manual ke is model ki limits ke andar hain.

solutions.en: Reduce the maximum solar charge current on the LCD to a lower value and restart to see if 33 clears.
solutions.ur: LCD par maximum solar charge current kam karke restart karein aur dekhein ke 33 hatta hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Power down and inspect the current sense divider and driver transistor on the charger board with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Power down karke charger board par current sense divider aur driver transistor multimeter se check karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Grid voltage low hai

meaning.en: Incoming grid voltage dropped below the acceptable window, so the unit left grid mode.
meaning.ur: Aane wala grid voltage acceptable range se neeche gir gaya, is liye unit grid mode se bahar aa gaya.

causes.en: Utility or generator supply has sagged, or a large motor is starting on the same line.
causes.ur: Utility ya generator ka supply gir gaya, ya usi line par koi bada motor start ho raha hai.

causes.en: Grid AC input cable is too thin or too long, causing a volt drop at the inverter terminals.
causes.ur: Grid AC input cable patli ya lambi hai jis se inverter terminal par voltage drop ho raha hai.

causes.en: The selectable AC input voltage range is set to a narrow UPS window instead of wide.
causes.ur: AC input voltage range narrow UPS window par set hai, wide ke bajaye.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter's AC input terminal, not at the meter, to see the real drop.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage meter par nahi, inverter ke AC input terminal par check karein taake asal drop pata chale.

solutions.en: On the LCD, widen the AC input voltage range to the wide appliance setting if the load can tolerate it.
solutions.ur: LCD par AC input voltage range wide appliance setting par karein agar load saha sake.

solutions.en: Upsize the grid AC cable and breaker per the manual's cable table to remove the volt drop.
solutions.ur: Volt drop hatane ke liye manual ki cable table ke mutabiq grid AC cable aur breaker upgrade karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Grid voltage high hai

meaning.en: Incoming grid voltage rose above the acceptable window, so the unit left grid mode.
meaning.ur: Aane wala grid voltage acceptable range se upar chala gaya, is liye unit grid mode se bahar aa gaya.

causes.en: Utility supply is over-voltage, or a generator is running without an AVR.
causes.ur: Utility supply over-voltage hai, ya generator bina AVR ke chal raha hai.

causes.en: Several inverters are grid-tied in parallel and back-feeding each other.
causes.ur: Kai inverters aik hi grid par grid-tie hain aur aik doosre ko back-feed kar rahe hain.

causes.en: Neutral to earth shift in the building makes the inverter see a higher phase voltage.
causes.ur: Building mein neutral se earth ka shift inverter ko zyada phase voltage dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter terminal over several minutes to confirm it is really above the limit.
solutions.ur: Kai minute tak inverter terminal par grid voltage check karein taake confirm ho ke woh sach mein limit se upar hai.

solutions.en: If a generator is feeding the unit, confirm the generator has a regulated AVR output.
solutions.ur: Agar generator unit ko feed kar raha hai to confirm karein ke generator ka output regulated AVR wala hai.

solutions.en: Check PE and neutral bonding so a shift is not inflating the measured voltage.
solutions.ur: PE aur neutral bonding check karein taake shift measured voltage ko barha kar na dikhaye.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Grid frequency low hai

meaning.en: Grid frequency fell below the accepted band, so the unit disconnected from grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency accepted range se neeche gir gaya, is liye unit grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Utility or generator is running at a low frequency, common on weak local grids.
causes.ur: Utility ya generator low frequency par chal raha hai, kamzor local grid par ye aam hai.

causes.en: Generator is overloaded and has dropped its speed and frequency.
causes.ur: Generator overload ho kar apni speed aur frequency gira chuka hai.

solutions.en: Read grid frequency on the LCD and compare it with 50 Hz for the local supply.
solutions.ur: LCD par grid frequency dekhein aur local supply ke 50 Hz se compare karein.

solutions.en: If a generator is the source, reduce the connected load so it holds frequency, then restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar source generator hai to connected load kam karein taake frequency stable rahe, phir inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: This is usually a self-clearing fault - the unit retries once frequency returns to the accepted band.
solutions.ur: Yeh aam tor par apne aap clear hota hai, frequency wapas aate hi unit dobara try karta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Grid frequency high hai

meaning.en: Grid frequency rose above the accepted band, so the unit disconnected from grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency accepted range se upar chala gaya, is liye unit grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Generator is running at too high a frequency or has a failed governor.
causes.ur: Generator bohat high frequency par chal raha hai ya uska governor kharab hai.

causes.en: Utility supply frequency is genuinely out of the national band.
causes.ur: Utility supply ki frequency wakai national range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Check frequency at the inverter's LCD and confirm it against the meter, so you know which device is wrong.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke LCD par frequency check karein aur meter se compare karein taake pata chale konsi device ghalat hai.

solutions.en: If a generator is the source, service its governor or AVR rather than changing the inverter setting.
solutions.ur: Agar source generator hai to inverter setting badalne ke bajaye uska governor ya AVR service karwayein.

solutions.en: Allow the unit to retry automatically once frequency is back in band before touching any wiring.
solutions.ur: Wiring chhoone se pehle frequency wapas aane par unit ko khud retry karne dein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Inverter over current protection chali

meaning.en: Output current exceeded the protection limit - a surge or an overload event tripped it.
meaning.ur: Output current protection limit se zyada ho gaya, surge ya overload ne protection chala di.

causes.en: A motor, compressor or pump started with a very high inrush current.
causes.ur: Koi motor, compressor ya pump bohat high inrush current ke saath start hua.

causes.en: AC output is shorted, or too many loads are connected.
causes.ur: AC output short hai ya bohat zyada loads lagi hain.

causes.en: Output current setting or the inverter's power rating is mismatched with the load.
causes.ur: Output current setting ya inverter ki power rating load se match nahi karti.

solutions.en: Restart the unit once, as the manual troubleshooting row for 51 instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ki 51 troubleshooting row ke mutabiq unit ek baar restart karein.

solutions.en: If the error comes back, reduce the connected load by switching off equipment one at a time.
solutions.ur: Agar error wapas aaye to equipment ek ek karke band kar ke connected load kam karein.

solutions.en: Check the load's rated current against the inverter's output current and move large motors to a separate unit.
solutions.ur: Load ka rated current inverter ke output current se compare karein aur bade motors alag unit par le jaayein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.en: Inverter bus voltage is too low
title.ur: Inverter bus voltage bahut low hai

meaning.en: The internal DC bus is too low to run the inverter stage; the manual groups it with restart advice.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus inverter stage chalane ke liye bahut low hai, manual ise restart advice ke saath group karta hai.

causes.en: Battery bank is deeply discharged or a battery string has opened.
causes.ur: Battery bank poori tarah discharge hai ya koi battery string open ho gayi hai.

causes.en: DC/DC boost stage or bus capacitor is faulty, so the bus cannot be built up.
causes.ur: DC/DC boost stage ya bus capacitor kharab hai jis se bus nahi ban pata.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter with only the battery connected, PV and AC isolated, as the manual instructs for 52.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq sirf battery ke saath inverter restart karein, PV aur AC disconnect karke.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and the DC fuse in the battery path; replace a blown fuse with the same rating.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage aur battery path ka DC fuse check karein, ube hua fuse usi rating ka lagayein.

solutions.en: If the fault continues with a healthy battery, the manual directs a main-board check of the boost and inverter stages.
solutions.ur: Agar sehatar battery par bhi fault rahe to manual boost aur inverter stages ka main board check karne kehta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Inverter soft start fail ho gaya

meaning.en: The inverter stage did not ramp up its output; the manual groups 53 with internal component failure.
meaning.ur: Inverter stage ne output ramp up nahi kiya, manual 53 ko internal component failure ke saath group karta hai.

causes.en: Soft-start resistor or soft-start relay on the main board has failed.
causes.ur: Main board par soft-start resistor ya soft-start relay kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Bus voltage is too low to start because the battery is flat.
causes.ur: Battery flat hone ki wajah se bus voltage start karne ke liye bahut low hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and measure the battery voltage; recharge the bank before retrying.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karke battery voltage check karein, dobara try karne se pehle bank recharge karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the soft-start resistor and relay on the main board with a multimeter; replace any open or burnt part.
solutions.ur: Main board par soft-start resistor aur relay multimeter se check karein, khula ya jala hua part replace karein.

solutions.en: The manual groups 08/09/53/57 as 'Internal components failed - return to repair centre', so plan for a board-level repair.
solutions.ur: Manual 08/09/53/57 ko 'Internal components failed - repair centre bhejein' ke tor par rakhta hai, board level repair ka plan karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.en: DC voltage present in AC output
title.ur: AC output par DC voltage aa rahi hai

meaning.en: DC has leaked into the AC output, so the unit shut down; the manual calls this an unbalanced output voltage.
meaning.ur: AC output mein DC leak ho gaya hai jis se unit band ho gaya, manual isay unbalanced output voltage kehta hai.

causes.en: A snubber or filter capacitor on the inverter bridge has failed and is passing DC.
causes.ur: Inverter bridge ka snubber ya filter capacitor kharab ho kar DC pass kar raha hai.

causes.en: One inverter IGBT or MOSFET is damaged, so its half bridge is not switching symmetrically.
causes.ur: Aik inverter IGBT ya MOSFET damage hua hai jis se uska half bridge symmetrical switch nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Damaged output filter or a capacitor that has leaked, allowing DC through the output.
causes.ur: Output filter ya capacitor damage hua hai jis se output se DC nikal raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, then measure DC volts on the AC output with a multimeter on the DC range.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir multimeter ko DC range par set karke AC output par DC voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check output filter and snubber capacitors on the main board for short or open with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Main board par output filter aur snubber capacitors ko multimeter se short ya open check karein.

solutions.en: If a power device is damaged, the manufacturer instructs replacing all devices in the bridge, not only the failed one.
solutions.ur: Agar koi power device damage hai to manufacturer kehta hai ke bridge ke tamam devices replace karein, sirf kharab wala nahi.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Battery connection open hai

meaning.en: The unit cannot see the battery bank, which usually means an open connection or a blown DC fuse.
meaning.ur: Unit battery bank ko nahi dekh pa raha, aam tor par iska matlab open connection ya ube hua DC fuse hai.

causes.en: Battery cable is not connected right, or a ring terminal has come off.
causes.ur: Battery cable theek se connected nahi, ya ring terminal nikal gaya hai.

causes.en: The DC fuse in the battery path has burnt out from a short or overload.
causes.ur: Battery path ka DC fuse short ya overload se jal chuka hai.

causes.en: A battery string is open because a cell has failed or a link is broken.
causes.ur: Koi battery string open hai kyun ke aik cell kharab ho gaya ya link toot gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery cable connection first, as the PV1800 HM service manual's 56 row directs.
solutions.ur: Pehle battery cable connection check karein, jaisa PV1800 HM service manual ki 56 row kehti hai.

solutions.en: Measure the DC fuse with a multimeter continuity test; replace it with the exact same amp rating and type.
solutions.ur: DC fuse ko multimeter continuity test se check karein, usi amp rating aur type ka lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery string and each cell with a multimeter to find the open string or the dead cell.
solutions.ur: Har battery string aur har cell ko multimeter se check kar ke khula string ya kharab cell dhoondein.

notes.en: The manual's TROUBLESHOOTING row for 56 reads: 'Battery is not connected well or fuse is burnt. If the battery is connected well, please return to repair center.'
notes.ur: Manual ki 56 TROUBLESHOOTING row hai: 'Battery is not connected well or fuse is burnt. Agar battery theek se connected hai to repair center bhejein.'

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Control current sensor mein ghalti

meaning.en: The control board's current sensing channel failed; the manual groups 57 with internal component failure.
meaning.ur: Control board ka current sensing channel kharab ho gaya, manual 57 ko internal component failure ke saath group karta hai.

causes.en: Control board current sense resistor or amplifier has failed.
causes.ur: Control board ka current sense resistor ya amplifier kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Sensing connector on the control board is loose or oxidised.
causes.ur: Control board par sensing connector loose ya oxidised hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the control board current sense connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir control board ka current sense connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Check the current sense resistor network with a multimeter and replace any open or drifted resistor.
solutions.ur: Current sense resistor network multimeter se check karein aur khula ya bigda hua resistor replace karein.

solutions.en: Treat 08/09/53/57 as a return-to-repair-centre group per the manual, since these indicate internal component failure.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq 08/09/53/57 ko repair centre wala group samajhein, ye internal component failure batata hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.en: Inverter output voltage is too low
title.ur: Inverter output voltage bahut low hai

meaning.en: Measured output voltage fell below the acceptable window; the manual pairs it with 06 in one troubleshooting row.
meaning.ur: Measured output voltage acceptable range se neeche gir gaya, manual isay 06 ke saath aik troubleshooting row mein rakhta hai.

causes.en: Battery bank is deeply discharged, so the inverter cannot hold output voltage.
causes.ur: Battery bank poori tarah discharge hai jis se inverter output voltage nahi tikka sakta.

causes.en: Output voltage sense circuit has drifted, so the unit trips on a false low reading.
causes.ur: Output voltage sense circuit bigad gaya hai jis se unit jhooti low reading par trip kar raha hai.

causes.en: Load draws more than the inverter can supply, pulling the output down.
causes.ur: Load inverter ki capacity se zyada kheech raha hai aur output neeche gira raha hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load first, as the manual's 06/58 row instructs, then restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Manual ki 06/58 row ke mutabiq pehle connected load kam karein, phir unit restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and recharge the bank if it is below the discharge cut-off.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage check karein aur woh discharge cut-off se neeche ho to bank recharge karein.

solutions.en: If load and battery are both healthy, return the unit to the repair centre as the manual row 06/58 states.
solutions.ur: Agar load aur battery dono sehatar hain to manual ki 06/58 row ke mutabiq unit repair centre bhejein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.en: Warning: fan locked while inverter is on
title.ur: Warning: fan chalti inverter mein atak gaya

meaning.en: The fan stalled after the inverter was already running; the manual lists it as a warning, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter chal raha tha aur uske baad fan atak gaya, manual isay warning batata hai fault nahi.

causes.en: Fan has been slowed by dust, hair or insects pulled in through the vents.
causes.ur: Vents se kheenchay gaye dust, baal ya keedhe fan ko slow kar dete hain.

causes.en: Fan bearings have worn and the motor draws too much current.
causes.ur: Fan ke bearings kharab ho gaye aur motor bohat zyada current kheech raha hai.

solutions.en: Note that the red Fault LED is flashing, not solid, for this warning - the unit is still supplying load.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke is warning mein red Fault LED flashing hai, solid nahi, unit load de raha hai.

solutions.en: At the next safe window, switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery and clean the fan and vents.
solutions.ur: Agli safe opportunity par off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein aur fan ke saath vents saaf karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan if it is noisy, slow or does not spin freely, then confirm the warning clears.
solutions.ur: Fan shor machata ho, slow ho ya azaad na ghoome to replace karein, phir confirm karein ke warning hat gayi.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.en: Warning: second fan locked while on
title.ur: Warning: doosra fan chalti inverter mein atak gaya

meaning.en: The unit has a second fan, and that one stalled while running; listed as a warning.
meaning.ur: Unit mein doosra fan hai aur woh chalte hue atak gaya, ye warning mein hai.

causes.en: Second fan is jammed by dust or its own bearing has seized.
causes.ur: Doosra fan dust se atak gaya hai ya uska bearing khud hi seize ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Second fan's supply or driver is weak, so it stalls under load.
causes.ur: Doosre fan ki supply ya driver kamzor hai jis se load par atak jaata hai.

solutions.en: Check both fans physically; the manual's 62 row simply states the second fan is locked while on.
solutions.ur: Dono fans ko dekh kar check karein, manual ki 62 row kehti hai ke doosra fan on hone par atka hua hai.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean or replace the second fan with the same rating.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir doosre fan ko saaf ya usi rating se replace karein.

solutions.en: Verify both fans spin from a cold start, because a stalled fan will escalate into fault 02 or 27.
solutions.ur: Dono fans ko cold start par ghoomne ka check karein, atka fan baad mein fault 02 ya 27 ban sakta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Warning: battery over-charge ho gayi

meaning.en: Battery voltage exceeded the normal charging window, so charging is limited.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage normal charging window se upar chala gaya, is liye charging limit ho gayi.

causes.en: Battery type is set wrong in the LCD menu, so the charge voltage is too high for the pack.
causes.ur: LCD menu mein battery type galat hai jis se pack ke liye charge voltage zyada set ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature is very high, so the charger has lifted the float voltage.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat high hai jis se charger ne float voltage barha di hai.

causes.en: Too many cells are wired in series for the pack design.
causes.ur: Pack design ke muqabl mein series mein zyada cells lagaye gaye hain.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter and compare it with the pack's recommended float voltage.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage multimeter se check karein aur pack ke recommended float voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Re-check the battery type and max charge voltage on the LCD, then let the charger settle and observe again.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery type aur max charge voltage dobara check karein, phir charger ko settle hone dein aur dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: If the voltage stays high with correct settings, remove the external charger and re-test, as the manual suggests for 03.
solutions.ur: Agar setting theek hone par bhi voltage high rahe to external charger nikaal kar dobara test karein, jaisa manual 03 ke liye kehta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Warning: battery low hai

meaning.en: Battery reached the low-voltage warning level and the unit is about to stop.
meaning.ur: Battery low voltage warning level par pahunch gaya aur unit rukne wala hai.

causes.en: Load is draining the battery faster than PV or AC can recharge it.
causes.ur: Load battery ko PV ya AC se recharge se tez drain kar raha hai.

causes.en: Battery bank has aged and no longer holds charge.
causes.ur: Battery bank umar ke saath ab charge hold nahi karti.

causes.en: AC input is absent, so only PV is available to recharge, and it is night or cloudy.
causes.ur: AC input mojood nahi hai jis se sirf PV recharge kar sakta hai aur raat ya badal chal rahi hai.

solutions.en: Read battery voltage and the load in W on the LCD to see the discharge rate.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery voltage aur watt mein load dekhein taake discharge rate pata chale.

solutions.en: Switch off non-essential loads so the battery recovers before it reaches the cut-off.
solutions.ur: Battery cut-off se pehle recover ho jaye uske liye ghair-zaroori loads band kar dein.

solutions.en: Recharge on AC or PV and check that charge current is actually flowing; if not, treat it as a battery wiring problem.
solutions.ur: AC ya PV se recharge karein aur check karein ke charge current actually ja raha hai, warna ise battery wiring masla samajhein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Warning: load zyada hai

meaning.en: Load is above the inverter's rated output; the manual lists it as a warning before it becomes fault 07.
meaning.ur: Load inverter ke rated output se zyada hai, manual isay fault 07 se pehle warning batata hai.

causes.en: More appliances are connected than the inverter's rated power.
causes.ur: Inverter ki rated power se zyada appliances lagi hain.

causes.en: A large motor or compressor is running alongside normal household load.
causes.ur: Normal ghar ke load ke saath koi bada motor ya compressor chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Add up the running load in watts on the LCD and keep it under rated power.
solutions.ur: LCD par chal rahe load ko watts mein jama karein aur rated power se neeche rakhein.

solutions.en: Switch off non-essential equipment before the warning becomes fault 07 and the unit stops.
solutions.ur: Warning fault 07 ban kar unit rukne se pehle ghair-zaroori equipment band kar dein.

solutions.en: Move heavy motor loads to a separate unit, since surge current is what usually pushes the inverter into overload.
solutions.ur: Bhaari motor load alag unit par le jaayein, kyunki surge current hi inverter ko overload mein daalta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Warning: output power kam kiya jaa raha hai

meaning.en: The inverter is deliberately reducing its output power, normally because grid voltage is low.
meaning.ur: Inverter apni output power jaan bujh kar kam kar raha hai, aam tor par grid voltage low hone ki wajah se.

causes.en: AC input voltage has dropped, so the unit derates to stay on grid.
causes.ur: AC input voltage gir gaya hai jis se unit grid par rehne ke liye power kam kar deta hai.

causes.en: Internal temperature is rising, so the unit derates to protect itself.
causes.ur: Internal temperature barh rahi hai jis se unit apni protection ke liye power kam karta hai.

solutions.en: Check grid voltage on the LCD; below the low-loss threshold the unit is designed to derate.
solutions.ur: LCD par grid voltage check karein, low-loss threshold se neeche unit ka derate hona by design hai.

solutions.en: Check whether heatsink temperature is also high, because 70 can precede fault 27.
solutions.ur: Yeh bhi check karein ke heatsink temperature high hai ya nahi, kyun ke 70 fault 27 se pehle aa sakta hai.

solutions.en: Upsize the grid AC cable or clear the supply if the voltage drop is a wiring problem.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage drop wiring ka masla hai to grid AC cable upgrade karein ya supply saaf karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.en: Warning: solar charger stopped, low battery
title.ur: Warning: solar charger battery low hone par ruk gaya

meaning.en: The MPPT charger has shut down to avoid over-discharging a low battery.
meaning.ur: MPPT charger ne low battery ko over-discharge hone se bachane ke liye band kar diya.

causes.en: Battery voltage is below the solar charge cut-off, often at night or in heavy cloud.
causes.ur: Battery voltage solar charge cut-off se neeche hai, aam tor par raat ya badal ke waqt.

causes.en: PV array is producing too little, so the charger would only deepen the discharge.
causes.ur: PV array bohat kam power bana raha hai jis se charger discharge aur badha dega.

solutions.en: Confirm battery voltage and PV power on the LCD so you know whether this is night-time or a PV fault.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery voltage aur PV power check karein taake pata chale ke ye raat ka waqt hai ya PV ka fault.

solutions.en: Do not force charging; let PV recharge the bank in daylight and check the PV Voc and connections if no PV shows.
solutions.ur: Zor se charging na karein, din mein PV se bank recharge hone dein aur PV dikhaya na de to PV Voc aur connections check karein.

solutions.en: On the PV1800 2K/3K HM service manual this code is a control-board replacement item, so if it never clears, escalate.
solutions.ur: PV1800 2K/3K HM service manual mein ye code control board replacement ka hai, agar kabhi clear na ho to escalate karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.en: Warning: solar charger stopped, high PV voltage
title.ur: Warning: solar charger zyada PV voltage par ruk gaya

meaning.en: The MPPT charger stopped because the PV array voltage is above the safe limit.
meaning.ur: MPPT charger ruk gaya kyun ke PV array ka voltage safe limit se upar hai.

causes.en: PV array open-circuit voltage exceeds the inverter's max PV Voc, often in cold weather.
causes.ur: PV array ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke max PV Voc se zyada hai, thande mausam mein ye aam hai.

causes.en: Too many panels in series for this model, with no voltage derating for temperature.
causes.ur: Is model ke liye series mein panels zyada hain aur temperature ke liye voltage derating nahi ki gayi.

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage at the inverter's PV terminals with a multimeter, inverter off.
solutions.ur: Inverter off kar ke multimeter se inverter ke PV terminals par PV open-circuit voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Compare that reading with the manual's maximum PV array open circuit voltage and remove panels if it is over.
solutions.ur: Us reading ko manual ke maximum PV array open circuit voltage se compare karein aur zyada ho to panels nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Check that the DC breaker between PV and inverter is closed, since an open breaker also stops solar charging.
solutions.ur: Yeh bhi check karein ke PV aur inverter ke darmiyan DC breaker band hai, kyun ke breaker khula hone par bhi solar charging rukti hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.en: Warning: solar charger stopped, over load
title.ur: Warning: solar charger load zyada hone par ruk gaya

meaning.en: The solar charger stopped because the PV array's output exceeded what the charger can handle.
meaning.ur: Solar charger ruk gaya kyun ke PV array ka output charger ki capacity se zyada tha.

causes.en: PV array wattage is larger than the inverter's maximum solar charge power.
causes.ur: PV array ki wattage inverter ke maximum solar charge power se zyada hai.

causes.en: Two strings are paralleled on one MPPT input without the unit's parallel-input support.
causes.ur: Do strings bina unit ke parallel input support ke aik MPPT input par jodi gayi hain.

solutions.en: Compare the PV array's rated wattage with the manual's maximum PV array power for this model.
solutions.ur: PV array ki rated wattage ko manual ke is model ke maximum PV array power se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the maximum solar charge current on the LCD to bring the charger inside its limit.
solutions.ur: LCD par maximum solar charge current kam karke charger ko uski limit ke andar laayein.

solutions.en: If the array is correctly sized and it still trips, check PV string fuses and connectors for a poor joint.
solutions.ur: Agar array theek size ka hai phir bhi trip karta hai to PV string fuses aur connectors mein kharab joint check karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Warning: solar charger zyada garm ho gaya

meaning.en: The MPPT charger has reduced or stopped charging because its own temperature is too high.
meaning.ur: MPPT charger ne apne temperature zyada hone ki wajah se charging kam ya band kar di.

causes.en: Ambient room temperature is very high, common in Pakistani summer installations.
causes.ur: Kamre ka ambient temperature bohat high hai, Pakistan mein garmiyon ke aam install mein ye aam hai.

causes.en: Charger heatsink is blocked by dust, or the cooling fan is not running.
causes.ur: Charger heatsink dust se band hai ya cooling fan nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Battery is hot, since the charger sits close to the battery compartment.
causes.ur: Battery garm hai kyun ke charger battery compartment ke qareeb hota hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the unit's own fan is running; the red LED flashing means warning, solid means fault.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke unit ka chal raha fan chal raha hai ya nahi, red LED flashing ka matlab warning hai solid ka matlab fault.

solutions.en: Install the unit with the documented clearance and out of direct sun on the heatsink.
solutions.ur: Unit ko documented clearance ke saath aise jagah lagayein ke heatsink par seedhi dhoop na pade.

solutions.en: Improve ventilation in the install room, since ambient temperature is the usual root cause of 75.
solutions.ur: Install room ki ventilation behtar karein, 75 ki aam wajah ambient temperature hi hoti hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Warning: PV charger se aaparas nahi ho raha

meaning.en: The PV charger board is not communicating correctly with the main controller.
meaning.ur: PV charger board main controller se theek se communicate nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Communication harness or connector between charger board and control board is loose.
causes.ur: Charger board aur control board ke darmiyan communication harness ya connector loose hai.

causes.en: Charger board has failed, so it no longer answers the controller.
causes.ur: Charger board kharab ho gaya hai jis se woh controller ka jawab nahi deta.

causes.en: Firmware versions between boards are mismatched after a partial update.
causes.ur: Partial update ke baad boards ke darmiyan firmware versions mismatch hain.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the inter-board communication cable at both ends.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir inter-board communication cable dono taraf se dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Check the harness for a broken conductor with a multimeter continuity test.
solutions.ur: Harness mein toota hua conductor multimeter continuity test se dhoondein.

solutions.en: Update the inverter firmware to the latest version from the OEM download portal so both boards match.
solutions.ur: Inverter firmware OEM download portal se latest par update karein taake dono boards match hon.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

title.ur: Warning: parameter ki ghalti

meaning.en: A stored setting is invalid or inconsistent, so the unit falls back or asks for reconfiguration.
meaning.ur: Koi stored setting invalid ya inconsistent hai jis se unit default par aata hai ya dobara configuration maangta hai.

causes.en: Settings were changed but the inverter was not restarted, so values are inconsistent.
causes.ur: Settings badle gaye lekin inverter restart nahi hua jis se values inconsistent hain.

causes.en: Battery type or battery voltage setting does not match the connected bank.
causes.ur: Battery type ya battery voltage setting connected bank se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Parameter memory was disturbed by a power cut during a save.
causes.ur: Save ke dauran power cut ki wajah se parameter memory bigad gaya.

solutions.en: Reboot the unit and re-read the battery type, charge voltage and output voltage settings from the LCD.
solutions.ur: Unit reboot karke LCD se battery type, charge voltage aur output voltage settings dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Correct the settings to match the actual battery spec sheet and the nominal battery voltage, then save and restart.
solutions.ur: Settings ko asli battery spec sheet aur nominal battery voltage se match karein, phir save karke restart karein.

solutions.en: If 77 keeps returning after correct settings, do a factory reset from the reset menu and set everything again from the manual.
solutions.ur: Agar setting theek hone par bhi 77 aata rahe to reset menu se factory reset karein aur manual ke mutabiq sab kuch dobara set karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)
